about_the_game:
Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG/CRPG in a cyberpunk world where your choices shape the city of the future.

A rotting seaside megacity is locked in a filthy war for freedom, while corporate overlords play god - your fate a decision, your life a resource.

Now choose: live as their puppet, or become the hero who writes a new chapter.

Add to wishlist - this directly helps the release and increases the visibility of the game on Steam.

  • Turn-based tactics: cover, line-of-sight, Action Point (AP) management, class interplay.

  • Classes & customization: roles, perks, attributes, flexible gear loadouts.

  • Implants & mods: upgrade body and weapons, prototype designs in your workshop.

  • Story-rich: your decisions reshape characters, districts, and the balance of power.

  • Cyberpunk locations: slums, rebel safehouses, corporate factories, and secret-ridden catacombs.

  • Interactive events: situations force hard choices - spend resources, betray allies, or risk your life.

  • Combat rewards focus: positioning, angles, timing, and exit routes.

  • Additional tools unlock unconventional plays: mark targets and disrupt enemy coordination.

  • Build toward your style with implants, modules, and gear. Choose what matters more: tactile feel or tactical edge.

  • Workshop: cobalt-chrome, controllers, wiring, and advanced polymers become mods and implants.

  • Hunt rare components via contracts, trading, and salvage and dismantling.

  • Implant software affects stability, perks, and side effects.

  • Perks set the pace: sprinter, tank, sniper, demolitionist, medic, scout.

  • Attributes (reflex, vitality, perception, tech) amplify your chosen role.

  • Grow across several paths, but you can’t be the best at everything.

  • Your father’s disappearance unearths old secrets.

  • The Resistance, the Order of Knights, and corporations pull you into their games. You decide whom to trust and what to risk; the whole city will feel the consequences.

  • A rooftop with chill music. Harbor warehouses. A panoramic boulevard. Underground catacombs.

  • Beyond the city lies Mirror Lake near Kreid-Wall. Old tech bays hide under the ice, and border scanners and checks can alter your route.

  • We are an indie team from Ukraine, in love with tactical gameplay and a human-centered future. Beyond the neon there’s humor, food, and music - the small things that make a city feel like home.

  • Step by step, we’re moving toward deeper immersion with micro-interactions.

  • Craft 2.0: more implants, technologies, and real material dilemmas.

  • Dynamic encounters: higher variety and replayability.

  • Party base: personal rooms, workbenches, and upgrades that affect missions.

  • New stories & districts: the port, the Dark Quarter, the panoramic boulevard, and more. (roadmap evolves with the community)

  • The city glows in neon and listens to your choice.

  • Like the vibe? Add Humanity Echo to your Wishlist and visit the Community Hub via the links on the store page - together we set the priorities for upcoming builds.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) / Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2–compatible GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris 2015+ or Apple GPU), MoltenVK/Vulkan
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2 or newer) / Intel Core i5 (2019 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or Radeon Pro 2018+, 4 GB VRAM, Metal 2
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
